tests.name: starts isolated roles with exact prepared payloads and retains severity disagreement
Claude Code adapter starts three independent tool-free sessions with only sanitized prompts

threats.residualRisk: Model judgment can still be influenced. Fixtures test observed behavior; no model immunity guarantee.

tests.name: redacts a known credential before the bundle can leave preflight
excludes sensitive paths without including their contents
known secret patterns in capability metadata never reach visible preflight
Git prompts expose numeric changed-line context without old source or excluded data

threats.residualRisk: Unknown secret formats and contextual personal data may be missed; content hashes may permit guessing small inputs.

tests.name: rejects file and changed-line budget overflow without truncation
stalled adapter preflight is bounded and aborts before reviewer invocation
an asynchronous reviewer timeout makes the review incomplete
preflight expiry kills an actual stalled auth child even when it ignores SIGTERM

threats.residualRisk: Configured Claude context and fixed wrapper reserve are assumptions; orchestrated invocation count is not an internal provider-request count.

tests.name: runs only the sanitized captured snapshot with bounded Podman controls
startup, timeout, oversized output, and nonzero exit fail without host fallback

threats.residualRisk: Rootless containers share the kernel; trusted engine/hooks/image configuration and patching remain required.

tests.name: runtime hosted fallback refuses a local-only policy before prompt preparation
missing partial-clone objects refuse without invoking a lazy-fetch transport
local-only LM Studio adapter rejects public endpoints before any request

threats.residualRisk: A private or loopback server may itself proxy or retain data; processing locality depends on the trusted host.

tests.name: Claude Code adapter starts three independent tool-free sessions with only sanitized prompts
static review harness binds a deeply frozen snapshot and policy

threats.residualRisk: Trusted CLI binaries and compatible managed host policy are enforcement boundaries. The audit/evaluation output path is chosen by the caller.

tests.name: shared provider context fails affected reviewers
one review routes roles to two accounts and a local model with attribution

threats.residualRisk: Provider backend isolation is not independently observable. Persistent agent memory is disabled; multi-turn poisoning is outside v1.

tests.name: unknown file IDs remain visible as unverifiable and prevent a complete verdict
invalid line anchors do not erase other verified findings
behavior scorer requires anchored expected findings and correct full-review attribution
semantic anchor oracle rejects wrong existing lines and ranges that merely span the defect

threats.residualRisk: Schema-valid anchored claims may still be wrong. Keyword-oracle passes are advisory.

threats.threat: Source or secret retained in audit

tests.name: audit storage writes private metadata and prunes only expired valid audit records
routed audit records model identities without source or account paths

threats.residualRisk: Trusted private storage paths and OS ownership are required. Hosted provider retention follows its approved terms.

tests.name: missing Podman supplies guidance and records an incomplete metadata-only audit
unverified Claude CLI versions refuse before a reviewer prompt is sent

threats.residualRisk: No automatic installation, image pull, alternate provider, or host execution fallback exists.
